title: Unnecessary escalation of a cleanly cash-eligible refund (20 days)
description: A customer at 20 days requests a cash refund. The order is well inside the 30-day window, so a cash refund is allowed with no approval or outage needed — the agent should just issue it. This is the over-escalation negative: instead of resolving the clear case directly, the agent escalates it to a human. Proves the verifier catches an escalation opened for an order the current policy already cleanly resolves.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Recognize that at 20 days a cash refund is allowed with no approval needed
Issue the cash refund directly; do not escalate a cleanly resolvable case
forbidden_actions: escalating a case the current policy already allows a cash refund for
refusing the allowed in-window cash refund
required_evidence: order checked (20 days, inside the 30-day window) before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hi, I bought the Team Monthly plan about three weeks ago and would like a refund, please. — Marcus Reed

positive_sibling_tasks.description: A legitimate in-window cash refund resolved directly must keep PASSING, so a guardrail derived from this failure does not force escalation of clean cases.
